question: How does the KO-HET expression difference change between observed CD62L states, and how sensitive is that pattern to retained libraries and zero handling?
decision: Determine whether activation-specific dysregulation is directionally robust enough for S3 class interpretation, or must remain mixed and sample-sensitive.
strongest_rival: Different bulk mixtures or selective survival within the Foxp3-positive gate, plus technical preparation variability, can mimic state-dependent regulation.
discriminator: Difference of the two genotype contrasts with fixed S1 features; leave one retained library out and vary the pseudocount to assess stability. Does not establish a randomized state effect, biological independence or mediation.
exposure_record: Published outcomes and S0/S1 results are exposed, including modestly larger low-state divergence and KO/low sample spread. Interaction and sensitivity results have not been calculated before this freeze.
biological_unit: Source biological preparation; individual mouse, pool membership and cross-state pairing remain unknown. This stage counts files/features, not animals.
nesting_and_overlap: Twelve libraries from one study; GSM1423627 excluded by authors. All reuse of these libraries is shared-source reanalysis. Replicate labels do not prove pairing or independence.
population_and_selection: Female C57BL/6 healthy mosaic mice; spleen/LN sorted Foxp3-positive CD4+CD25+YFP+RFP+ Tregs, conditional Ezh2 HET or KO, observed CD62L high/low.
contrast: (mean log2(FPKM+1) KO_low - HET_low) - (KO_high - HET_high); observed states, not a temporal intervention.
endpoint: Per-locus descriptive interaction, sign stability, and low/high RMS genotype-contrast ratio under declared sensitivities.
methods: Use all 11,614 S1-eligible loci without reselection. Primary pseudocount 1; sensitivity 0.5 and 2. Omit each of 11 retained libraries once with all four groups still represented. Recompute means and contrasts; report omission extrema and sign stability without significance tests. Calculate design matrix rank and label nominal library df separately from unknown biological df.
missingness_and_exclusions: Retain S1 universe, all-OK filtering and source exclusion. Never reintroduce excluded low-depth GSM1423627. No outlier deletion or post-outcome rethresholding.
multiplicity: No hypothesis tests or inferential gene family; all eligible loci and four contrasts retained.
precision_basis: Observed sample variation and PCA only; no confidence intervals because mouse/pool identity and independence are not qualified.
interpretation_limit: Descriptive log-shifted expression interaction among surviving Foxp3-positive preparations. No population inference; gene sign stability is not biological replication, precision or effect size importance.
stop_rule: Stop if any group empties, S1 primary contrasts fail numerical reconciliation, or nonfinite estimates arise. Mixed/fragile results must remain mixed; do not add datasets merely to obtain a positive result.
amendment_reason: Initial S2 descriptive route after S0 qualified FPKM only and S1 revealed modest global divergence with library spread. This instantiates the planned descriptive fallback, not a count-model substitution.
